title: “你一生的故事”
excerpt: 这一切都要从那串手链说起。。。

title: 在留白处落笔
excerpt: 开一个极简个人志，不为涨粉，只为给思考留一块不被算法催促的空地。
excerpt_en: Starting a minimal journal — not for an audience, but to keep a patch of ground where thought is not hurried by an algorithm.

title: 读一本不说话的书
title_en: Reading a Book That Says Nothing
excerpt: 有些书的价值不在它说了什么，而在它替你留出了一段沉默，让你听见自己的声音。
excerpt_en: Some books are valuable not for what they say, but for the silence they leave you — long enough to hear your own voice.

title: 没有真相，只有视角
excerpt: 我们以为在争论事实，其实常常只是在交换各自站位的视角。视角不是 relativism，是一种清醒。
excerpt_en: We think we are arguing about facts, when often we are only exchanging the views from where we stand. Perspective is not relativism; it is a form of clarity.
